info.cls_name: 工程與科學學院碩士綜合班
info.cls_ename: Master's Course at College of Engineering and Science

description.describe_ch: 教導學生半導體製程之設備專業知識，配合實務操作、系統模擬及值班實境演練，強化學生畢業前培養融入公司文化及工程技術養成，獨立思考，透過半導體製程之設備、設備元件之課程學習，建立理論知識與實務之連結，實地驗證課程所學，建構未來就業基礎。
description.describe_eh: Teach students the professional knowledge of semiconductor process equipment, cooperate with the practical operation, system simulation, and on-duty practice, strengthen the cultivation of students before graduation, integrate into the company culture, and develop engineering technology and independent thinking through the course, learning of semiconductor process equipment and equipment components, establishing the connection between theoretical knowledge and practice, field verification of course learning, and construction of a future employment foundation.

targets.describe_en: Understand the importance of semiconductor equipment components in the semiconductor process

targets.describe_ch: 結合理論知識初步了解半導體設備與元件
targets.describe_en: Combining theoretical knowledge with a preliminary understanding of semiconductor equipment and components

targets.describe_ch: 培養融入公司文化及工程技術養成
targets.describe_en: Cultivate and integrate into company culture and develop engineering technology
